d: China’s stock market has lost around $3.5 trillion in value since its peak, as weak consumer demand, falling corporate earnings and a global sell-off in AI stocks weigh on investor confidence. In this video, Firstpost examines why Beijing’s efforts to stabilise the market have yet to resolve deeper economic concerns, even as China reports 4.5% growth in the third quarter. The focus then shifts to the Chinese Communist Party’s latest meeting, centred on discipline, loyalty and corruption under President Xi Jinping.
